description:
ForgeLyte Lift is a focused workout log built for lifters who want to track their training without social feeds, AI coaching, or unnecessary clutter.

Start a workout, log every set, and see your previous numbers while you train. Save routines for repeat sessions, let the automatic rest timer keep you moving, and watch your progress build over time.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO TRACK YOUR LIFTS

• Log weight, reps, warm-up sets and working sets
• Track set effort using RPE or RIR
• Create supersets and reusable workout routines
• Repeat previous workouts in seconds
• See your previous performance while logging
• View and edit your complete workout history
• Automatically detect personal records for weight, volume and estimated 1RM
• Explore workout frequency, training volume and exercise progress charts
• Use pounds or kilograms
• Set daily workout reminders
• Export your complete history to CSV
• Personalize the app with your preferred accent colour

PRIVATE AND FOCUSED

No account is required. Your workout data is stored locally, so you can train and review your history even when the gym has poor reception.

Whether you train for strength, bodybuilding or powerlifting, ForgeLyte Lift keeps the process simple: log the work, review your progress and get back to lifting.
